posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform How China's gray market sells Claude tokens at a fraction of the price The Decoder · 🟧 Claude · 2h ago • China bypasses Anthropic's geoblocking and identity verification to resell Claude tokens at 90% discount. • Gray market transfer stations enable Chinese developers to access restricted AI services at fraction of official price. • Anthropic's access controls demonstrably ineffective against organized resale networks in China. 🌐 AI Industry AI is becoming AI's biggest customer as agentic token usage jumps 14x on OpenRouter The Decoder · 14m ago • AI agents surpassed humans as primary token consumers on OpenRouter since February 6, 2025. • Agentic usage grew 14x versus 2.8x for human usage, driven largely by cached prompt optimization. • AI-to-AI consumption now dominates token economics despite lower apparent costs from caching strategies. 🌐 AI Industry AI could make scientists do more work less well, not less work better, study argues The Decoder · 1h ago • AI's time savings may reduce research quality by redirecting freed hours to new projects rather than improving existing ones. • Theoretical study argues perfect AI could worsen rather than improve scientific outcomes through perverse incentives. • Efficiency gains paradoxically increase pressure to produce more work rather than better work.
